dialogue.ja: 大寒が新しい春を迎えます。

dialogue.text: Around January 20th is Tahan, Major cold, the last solar term.
dialogue.zh: 大約在一月二十日是大寒，二十四節氣的最後一個節氣。
dialogue.ja: 1月20日頃は大寒、24節気の最後の節気です。
dialogue.local: Around January 20th is Tahan, Major cold, the last solar term.
dialogue.en: Around January 20th is Tahan, Major cold, the last solar term.

dialogue.text: This is the grand finale of the 24 solar terms.
dialogue.zh: 這是二十四節氣的壓軸。
dialogue.ja: これは24節気のグランドフィナーレです。
dialogue.local: This is the grand finale of the 24 solar terms.
dialogue.en: This is the grand finale of the 24 solar terms.

dialogue.text: The cold is at its deepest.
dialogue.ja: 寒さが最も厳しい時期です。
dialogue.local: The cold is at its deepest.
dialogue.en: The cold is at its deepest.

dialogue.text: But people are already getting excited.
dialogue.zh: 但人們已經開始興奮起來。
dialogue.ja: しかし、人々はすでにわくわくしています。
dialogue.local: But people are already getting excited.
dialogue.en: But people are already getting excited.

dialogue.ja: 春節が近づいています。

dialogue.text: They start cleaning houses, buying decorations, and making new year food.
dialogue.zh: 他們開始打掃房子，買裝飾品，做年節食物。
dialogue.ja: 家を掃除し、飾りを買い、正月料理を作り始めます。
dialogue.local: They start cleaning houses, buying decorations, and making new year food.
dialogue.en: They start cleaning houses, buying decorations, and making new year food.

dialogue.text: The coldest days carry the warmest expectations.
dialogue.zh: 最冷的日子帶著最溫暖的期望。
dialogue.ja: 最も寒い日々には最も温かい期待が込められています。
dialogue.local: The coldest days carry the warmest expectations.
dialogue.en: The coldest days carry the warmest expectations.

dialogue.text: After Major cold, the cycle starts again with start of spring.
dialogue.zh: 大寒之後，循環再次從春天開始。
dialogue.ja: 大寒の後、春の始まりとともに循環が再び始まります。
dialogue.local: After Major cold, the cycle starts again with start of spring.
dialogue.en: After Major cold, the cycle starts again with start of spring.

dialogue.text: The 24 solar terms are a beautiful wheel that turns forever.
dialogue.zh: 二十四節氣是一個永遠轉動的美麗輪子。
dialogue.ja: 24節気は永遠に回り続ける美しい輪です。
dialogue.local: The 24 solar terms are a beautiful wheel that turns forever.
dialogue.en: The 24 solar terms are a beautiful wheel that turns forever.

dialogue.text: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, and spring again.
dialogue.zh: 春、夏、秋、冬，然後又是春天。
dialogue.ja: 春、夏、秋、冬、そしてまた春です。
dialogue.local: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, and spring again.
dialogue.en: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, and spring again.
